description: This file contains implementations of inverse hyperbolic functions (sinh, cosh, tanh) using PRAT (probably arbitrary precision rational) representations, including functions for asinh, acosh, and atanh.

methods.name: asinhrat
methods.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic sine (asinh) of a PRAT number, using Taylor series for approximation when |x| >= 0.85, otherwise using log-based formula.

methods.name: acoshrat
methods.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic cosine (acosh) of a PRAT number, using log of x + sqrt(x^2 - 1). Throws domain error if x < 1.

methods.name: atanhrat
methods.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic tangent (atanh) of a PRAT number, using logarithmic formula.
